definitions.explanation: Having a full, rounded physical form that suggests sensuality or physical appeal. Describes a body type or appearance that emphasizes curves and fleshiness in an attractive way.

examples.japanese: {肉感|にっかん}{的|てき}な{体型|たいけい}をしている。
ルーベンスの{絵画|かいが}は{肉感|にっかん}{的|てき}な{女性|じょせい}を{多|おお}く{描|えが}いている。
examples.english: Rubens' paintings frequently depict voluptuous women.

examples.japanese: その{女優|じょゆう}は{肉感|にっかん}{的|てき}な{魅力|みりょく}で{観客|かんきゃく}を{引|ひ}きつけた。
examples.english: The actress attracted audiences with her sensual charm.

notes:
Composed of {肉感|にっかん} (fleshy sensation; physical sensuality) + {的|てき} (-ive; -al). Functions as a na-adjective. Describes physical attractiveness that emphasizes fullness and curves. Not inherently negative — it can be appreciative, especially in art criticism and fashion.

USAGE:
Most commonly describes women's bodies or artistic depictions thereof. Can also describe the quality of certain art styles, performances, or literary descriptions that emphasize physicality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肉感|にっかん}{的|てき}な{体|からだ}: a voluptuous body
- {肉感|にっかん}{的|てき}な{魅力|みりょく}: sensual charm
- {肉感|にっかん}{的|てき}な{唇|くちびる}: full, sensual lips

SIMILAR WORDS:
- グラマー: glamorous; curvaceous — loanword, more casual and modern
- {官能|かんのう}{的|てき}: sensual; erotic — more explicitly sexual
- {豊満|ほうまん}: plump; voluptuous — emphasizes fullness without the sensual overtone
- セクシー: sexy — loanword, broader and more casual
